description: This file defines the MainViewModel class for an Android app, handling data operations such as fetching recipes, managing favorites, categories, notes, and search results via a repository pattern. It interacts with live data for UI updates.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class managing recipe data, favorites, categories, notes, and search results using a repository, and exposing LiveData for UI updates.

classes.name: MainViewModelFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of MainViewModel with a provided repository.

methods.name: refreshRecipes
methods.description: Fetches recipes, categories, and favorites from the repository and updates corresponding LiveData.

methods.name: loadRecipe
methods.description: Loads detailed information of a specific recipe by ID.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Sets or unsets a recipe as favorite and refreshes the recipes list.

methods.name: addOrUpdateRecipe
methods.description: Adds a new recipe or updates an existing one, then refreshes the recipes list.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search query and updates search result LiveData.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes associated with a specific recipe.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a new note to a recipe and reloads notes.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note and reloads notes for the associated recipe.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of MainViewModel with a repository.
